title: Home practical guide and safety card: soil drainage test
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Soils and aquatic plants (Flow and One Planet, Our World)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 28 (Home practical guide and safety card: soil drainage test (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 28: Which soil drains best?. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out which soil lets water through fastest
equipment: Three plastic cups with small holes in the bottom (adult makes them)
Three soils: sandy, garden soil, clay
A measuring jug and a timer
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Put the same amount of each soil in a cup
Stand each cup on a jar
Pour 100 ml of water into the first cup and start the timer
After 5 minutes, measure the water in the jar
Repeat with the other soils, using the same water and time
Draw a bar chart of the results

questions.q: Big question: why do some gardens stay puddly for days?
questions.a: They have clay soil, which drains slowly and holds water.
